annotations.title: Roof plan as a DXF drawing (Dachcheck)

description: The plan behind a Dachcheck link as a DXF drawing (R12, metres) for CAD or a mounting planner: the roof from above, and below it each face unfolded at its true size, with modules, obstacles and dormers on their own layers. Comes back inside this answer as an embedded resource (application/dxf, base64); save it as a file. Nothing is stored.

link.description: A Dachcheck link (https://pv.skysolar.de/dachcheck/#d=…), as plan_roof, edit_roof or the Dachcheck page gave it.
